name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=dialog). Name accurately describes the operation: restoring the saved 0x48x0x48 dialog-area patch from data_fd2_dialog_area_backup_buffer back into the working framebuffer. No Ghidra address residue; no domain IDs present. It is the exact inverse of fd2_backup_dialog_area_to_buffer @ 0x175A9, so the 'restore..from_buffer' phrasing pairs cleanly with 'backup..to_buffer'.
purpose: Restore the dialog-area background (a 0x48x0x48 pixel patch) that was snapshotted before an overlaid settings/status dialog was drawn, copying it from the backup buffer back into the working framebuffer at the cursor corner.
logic_summary: Computes the destination anchor in the working framebuffer = large_game_state_buffer + 0x8088 + (cursor_screen_x-1)*0x18 (one tile-column left) + (cursor_screen_y-1)*0x2AC0 (one tile-row up), giving the top-left corner one tile up/left of the cursor. Then loops row=0..0x47, memmove'ing 0x48 bytes per row from data_fd2_dialog_area_backup_buffer (source stride 0x48, tightly packed) to the destination (advancing dst by working-buffer stride 0x1C8 each row). Exact inverse of fd2_backup_dialog_area_to_buffer.
notes: Clean function, no changes needed. src comment block (dialog.c lines 761-793) already precise and matches decompile + caller context (fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide @ 0x1741C calls it once during the open slide; fd2_close_settings_dialog_with_slide @ 0x176B4 calls it twice -- per-frame during the inward collapse and once for final cleanup). Ghidra plate consistent with src understanding, left untouched. The decompile's __CHK(0x18) stack-probe prologue is a Watcom artifact intentionally omitted from src (consistent with sibling fd2_backup_dialog_area_to_buffer); not game logic. Globals all declared in src/include/globals.h with matching names. params=[] (void).
